name: StickS3 Intercom + BLE HID
description: Intercom firmware for M5Stack StickS3 using ESP-NOW and/or Wi-Fi. Supports mixed networks of multiple StickS3 and AtomS3R units, browser peers over HTTPS, peer selection, spy mode, live/clip audio, plus a standalone BLE keyboard/mouse controller with web UI. Wi-Fi and ESP-NOW-only units can communicate together.
keywords: ESP32-S3, M5Stack, StickS3, Intercom, BLE HID, ESP-NOW, LittleFS
author: Robot-icist
